facts.business: Comfort Fincap Limited is a non-deposit taking NBFC registered with RBI and classified as base layer, providing lending solutions including Loan Against Securities, Promoter Funding, Consumer Durable Loans, Supply Chain Financing and Bill Discounting to individuals, MSMEs, corporates and institutions.
